Hi Liz / Sanjay,

Thanks for reaching out — happy to get a CAIQ intake scheduled. Our intake call typically runs 30–45 minutes and covers: scope (environments + data residency), evidence owners, and any high-visibility control questions.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Mon Apr 19 10:00–10:30
- Tue Apr 20 14:00–14:45
- Wed Apr 21 09:30–10:15

If none of those work, please share a couple of times that do.

Prep: I attached a current CAIQ snapshot and a quick sample-logs checklist that helps us identify evidence owners ahead of the call. Having a named person for each area (logging, identity, infra) speeds the process up.

Att: redwood_caiq_v1.2.xlsx (xlsx)
Att: sample-logs-instructions.txt (txt)

On the call we can also confirm whether you want a SOC 2 scoping conversation in the same session or a follow-up.

Quick notes before the call:
- We have three deployment regions (us-west, eu-west, ap-southeast) — primary data residency is us-west.
- We maintain a central logging pipeline (Elastic + S3 archive) with 365d retention.
